arxiv-2101-06266.title: Parameter inference in a computational model of hemodynamics in pulmonary hypertension
arxiv-2101-06266.creator: Amanda L. Colunga *, Mitchel J. Colebank *, REU Program, Mette S. Olufsen
arxiv-2101-06266.description: Abstract Pulmonary hypertension (PH), defined by a mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) > > 20 mmHg, is characterized by increased pulmonary vascular resistance and decreased pulmonary arterial compliance. There are few measurable biomarkers of PH progression, but a conclusive diagnosis of the disease requires invasive right heart catheterization (RHC).

arxiv-2106-06733.title: LENAS: Learning-based Neural Architecture Search and Ensemble for 3D Radiotherapy Dose Prediction
arxiv-2106-06733.creator: Yi Lin, Yanfei Liu, Hao Chen, Xin Yang, Kai Ma, Yefeng Zheng, Kwang-Ting Cheng
arxiv-2106-06733.description: Abstract Radiation therapy treatment planning requires balancing the delivery of the target dose while sparing normal tissues, making it a complex process. To streamline the planning process and enhance its quality, there is a growing demand for knowledge-based planning (KBP).

arxiv-2506-19672.title: Impact of the ambipolar diffusion in the structuration of the magnetic Rayleigh Taylor instability with oblique magnetic field
arxiv-2506-19672.creator: E. Callies, V. Guillet, A. Marcowith, Z. Meliani, P. Lesaffre
arxiv-2506-19672.description: Abstract Aims. We investigate the impact of ambipolar diffusion on the development of the Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI) with an oblique magnetic field in the incompressible limit. Methods. We developed a general bi-fluid framework comprising charges and neutrals with the specific feature of differing gravity between charges and neutrals.

pmc-11367656.title: A case of organizing pneumonia in rearranged during transfection fusion‐positive lung adenocarcinoma treated with selpercatinib
pmc-11367656.creator: Hiroki Ohkoshi, Masafumi Saiki, Nozomu Takahashi, Kenta Homma, Satoshi Furuya, So Shimamura, Chisa Omori, Yuki Hoshino, Yoshinori Uchida, Shinnosuke Ikemura, Kenzo Soejima
pmc-11367656.description: Selpercatinib is the first targeted therapy for rearranged during transfection (RET) fusion‐positive unresectable non‐small‐cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The main adverse effects of selpercatinib include hypertension, liver dysfunction, diarrhea, and QT prolongation on electrocardiograms. However, instances of drug‐induced interstitial lung disease (DI‐ILD) are infrequently reported.

pmc-11397071.title: Optimizing cannabis cultivation: an efficient in vitro system for flowering induction
pmc-11397071.creator: Orly Lavie, Kobi Buxdorf, Leor Eshed Williams
pmc-11397071.description: BackgroundCannabis sativa L. is a versatile medicinal plant known for its therapeutic properties, derived from its diverse array of secondary metabolites synthesized primarily in female flower organs. Breeding cannabis is challenging due to its dioecious nature, strict regulatory requirements, and the need for photoperiod control to trigger flowering, coupled with highly dispersible pollen that can easily contaminate nearby female flowers.

pmc-11411713.title: Toward the Use of Methyl-Coenzyme M Reductase for Methane Bioconversion Applications
pmc-11411713.creator: Thuc-Anh Dinh, Kylie D. Allen
pmc-11411713.description: ConspectusAs the main component of natural gas and renewable biogas, methane is an abundant, affordable fuel. Thus, there is interest in converting these methane reserves into liquid fuels and commodity chemicals, which would contribute toward mitigating climate change, as well as provide potentially sustainable routes to chemical production.

pmc-11421044.title: Efficacy and mechanism of action of ginsenoside Rg3 on radiation proctitis in rats
pmc-11421044.creator: Xuxia Li, Lili Lin, Xiaoyu Duan, Jiuju Dai, Tingting Hu, Hongyi Cai
pmc-11421044.description: ObjectiveRadiation proctitis (RP) refers to rectal injury caused by radiation treatment of pelvic and retroperitoneal malignancies, which has a major impact on the treatment prognosis and quality of life of patients with cancer. The tetracyclic triterpene saponin monomer ginsenoside Rg3 (GRg3), the primary bioactive ingredient in ginseng extracts, has therapeutic effects against RP in rats.

pmc-11644605.title: The Relationship of Pork Meat Consumption with Nutrient Intakes, Diet Quality, and Biomarkers of Health Status in Korean Older Adults
pmc-11644605.creator: Ah-Jin Jung, Anshul Sharma, Mei Chung, Taylor C. Wallace, Hae-Jeung Lee
pmc-11644605.description: Background: Pork meat is a widely consumed protein food with the potential to differentially affect health and nutritional status across social and cultural contexts. Objectives: We evaluated the association between pork meat consumption and nutrient intake, diet quality, and biomarkers of health among older adults (age ≥ 65 years) in Korea.

pmc-12928498.title: One health at the last mile: Multi-scale predictors of Schistosoma japonicum infection in southwest China across two decades of control
pmc-12928498.creator: William W. Zou, Elise N. Grover, Liu Yang, Elizabeth J. Carlton, Robert Adamu SHEY, Robert Adamu SHEY, Robert Adamu SHEY
pmc-12928498.description: In China, schistosomiasis is targeted for elimination. As the country approaches elimination, it is critical to evaluate how the dynamics of transmission are changing in remaining pockets of disease. We have been studying areas of schistosomiasis reemergence and persistence in Sichuan, China since 2007.

pmc-13582723.title: Preparation methods, mechano-bactericidal performance and mechanisms of Ti-based nanostructure arrays: A review
pmc-13582723.creator: Wenfang Li, Shujiao Zhang, Rui Liu, Fangchong Xing, Xingcai Guo, Lidan Zhao
pmc-13582723.description: Medical titanium (Ti) and its alloys have been widely employed in biomedical field, but Ti-based implants are prone to bacterial biofilm contamination, leading to implant failure. Nanostructure arrays, as a new strategy, exhibit effective bactericidal performance and biofilm inhibition only by using their own morphological characteristics, drawing extensive attention.

pmc-13672673.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of PID‐5‐BF for Screening Personality Disorders: A Cross‐Sectional Study in Clinical and Nonclinical Samples
pmc-13672673.creator: Béla Birkás, András Norbert Zsidó, Sára Gergely, Regina Tóth, Júlia Andróczi, Tibor Cece Kiss, András Láng
pmc-13672673.description: The DSM‐5 Alternative Model for Personality Disorders introduced a dimensional approach to personality pathology, with maladaptive traits assessed by the Personality Inventory for DSM‐5 Brief Form (PID‐5‐BF). Despite extensive validation, evidence on its diagnostic accuracy and empirically derived cutoff scores remains limited.
